records.failureSummary: Added AC-numbered tests for store.update/store.remove and consolidated them into the tracked test file test/app.test.mjs (pure append; the two pre-existing tests are untouched), because the previous red-light verdict failed with 'vacuous tests' as the AC tests lived only in untracked test/store.test.mjs and were therefore invisible to the diff-based fail-first check. test/store.test.mjs was reduced to a comment stub so the tests do not run twice. No product code was modified. Fail-first: against the pre-implementation placeholder store (update/remove throw 'update not implemented'/'remove not implemented', still present at HEAD) the 7 new tests fail (0 passed / 7 failed, exit 1); against the real implementation they pass. Run results: npm run test -> 10/10 pass, 0 fail, 0 errors, exit 0; npm run build -> exit 0; npm run lint -> exit 0. pnpm is not installed in the sandbox (exit 127, sh: pnpm: not found), so the exact underlying commands the pnpm scripts wrap were executed directly (node --test; node --check on src/app.mjs, src/store.mjs, src/serve.mjs). No existing assertions were weakened and no new framework or dependency was added.
